headline: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO sees muted 0.15x subscription on first day
summary: State-owned Mahanadi Coalfields recorded a 0.15 times subscription rate on day one of its initial public offering after raising ₹2,295 crore from anchor investors.
why: Mahanadi Coalfields is one of the primary coal-producing subsidiaries of India's state-owned Coal India.
